title: רב הונא בר מנוח

paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Manoach, in Rav Acha son of Rav Ika’s name: Gittin 24a, 64b; Megillah 25b; Bekhorot 28b, 45a; Bava Kamma 58b; Bava Metzia 71b; Sanhedrin 42a. However, in Bava Kamma 22, end of side a, it is in Rav Ika’s name; perhaps it should read Rav Acha bar Ika’s name. In Yevamot 43a: in Rav Idi son of Rav Ika’s name—a scribal error; it should read Acha. In Taanit 9, end of side a, he, Rav Shmuel bar Idi, and Rabbi Chiyya of Vastanya frequented Rava. When he died, they came before Rav Pappa, but he did not explain satisfactorily to them, and they signaled to one another. Rav Pappa was distressed; they read to him in a dream, “I cut off the three shepherds in one month,” and so it happened.
